answer: The vine schedule is applied in dune and ridge shows each instalment. A payout is split thus 30% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Anyone therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2220 identities would post 2370 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
